$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFNG (AIP France, chart dated 2024-08-08): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart for the notes, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty.

The reporting points are in French: "location" is the name printed in the French column of the chart, copied and not translated, and "purpose" is written in French; a point whose French name could not be read has no "location". Only "spoken.en" is English: the name the English phraseology says over the radio.

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Parallel TWY not available after heavy rainfalls.
Site likely to be covered by sea haze in a few minutes.
Particular caution must be observed by LFNG users on heavy commercial and training activity in Montpellier CTR.
A request for clearance from Montpellier TWR 118.775 is mandatory before entering Montpellier CTR.
After take-off, risk of intrusion into Montpellier CTR, due to its proximity: Take-off from QFU 322°: turn right and avoid Mudaison and Baillargues.
Take-off from QFU 142°: turn left, and stay north of the «Rhône à Sète» canal,; direct to ER and/or AM prohibited without clearance from Montpellier TWR.
Traffic circuits: Bypass Candillargues via North.
Cross-wind leg QFU 322° or base leg QFU 142° is located midway between built-up areas of Mudaison and Candillargues.
Downwind leg exclusively East of Berange river.
Preferred QFU: 142° due to environment.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
Voie de circulation parallèle inutilisable après fortes précipitations.
Site susceptible d'être envahi en quelques minutes par la brume de mer.
Une attention particulière doit être observée par les usagers de LFNG sur la forte activité IFR commerciale et d'entraînement dans la CTR MONTPELLIER.
Une demande de clairance auprès de MONTPELLIER TOUR 118.775 est obligatoire avant de pénétrer dans la CTR Montpellier.
Après décollage, risque d'intrusion dans la CTR de Montpellier, du fait de sa proximité : Décollage en QFU 322 ° : virer à droite et éviter les communes de Mudaison et Baillargues.
Décollage en QFU 142° : virer à gauche, et rester au nord du canal du Rhône à.
Circuits en vol : Contourner l'agglomération de Candillargues par le Nord.
La branche vent traversier QFU 322° ou base QFU 142° se fera à mi-distance entre l'agglomération de Mudaison et celle de Candillargues.
La branche vent arrière se fera exclusivement à l'Est de la rivière Berange.
QFU 142° préférentiel cause environnement.
